Girls' Morning Out

Gladeville, TN · Road

Women / trans / femme

Girls' Morning Out is a road group ride in Gladeville, TN. It rolls every Friday at 8:00 am from Gladeville Community Center. Pace: 14–16+ mph.

About the Girls' Morning Out group ride

A Friday morning women's ride on Wilson County back roads. The club says it is a girls' ride but not exclusive, so anyone is welcome. Cancelled for rain at start time.
